speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: The turbines may be above the water, but their effects do not stop at the surface.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Construction and operation of the wind park generate underwater noise and vibrations.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: These disturbances can interfere with the communication, navigation and feeding behaviour of fish and marine mammals.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Prolonged disturbance may also cause species to avoid parts of their traditional habitat.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: At the same time, the structures themselves could potentially provide new habitats for marine species.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has obligations under UNCLOS to prevent, reduce and control pollution of the marine environment.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The legal status of underwater noise as marine pollution is still subject to interpretation, but precautionary measures can reduce Arcadia's environmental and legal risks.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: The challenge is therefore not simply whether the wind park affects marine life, but how we can reduce those effects.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: This is an important part of Arcadia's responsibility under SDG 14.
